results.title: CJP claims ‘massive’ victory after Rajasthan Govt orders ₹18 Lakh repairs for ‘buffalo-shed’ school near Jaipur
results.description: In a statement issued on Saturday, the Rajasthan government said financial approval of ₹12 lakh was issued from the District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT) fund on August 13, 2026. Additionally, ₹6 lakh has been approved from the MLA fund.

results.title: ‘Main Bhi Nahi Sudhar Raha Hoon’: Rahul Gandhi on Abuse Over Questioning Govt at Pune’s 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' (Watch)
results.description: Congress leader and Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi stated on Saturday that he has endured years of abuse for questioning the government on uncomfortable issues, asserting that he will not be "straightened up" or silenced.

results.title: Aroma Chundan creates a splash in maiden season, wins Nehru Trophy
results.description: Aroma Chundan surged to victory after overcoming an initial setback and powering ahead in the final stretch.
